Package be.imgn.swing.docking

@NullMarked package be.imgn.swing.docking
Docking: views docked in a frame, split and tabbed, rearranged by the user, opened and closed while the frame is open, their layout saved with the frame's window state.
  • Related Packages
    Module
    Package
    Description
    be.imgn.swing
    be.imgn.swing
    The core of swing: what an application needs outside its user interface.
  • Class
    Description
    Dock
    The dock of a frame: views docked in it, split and tabbed, which the user rearranges, opened and closed while the frame is open, their layout saved with the frame's window state.
    Docked
    The place of a dock view in its dock, which the view injects: its title, shown on its tab and in its header.
    DockLayout
    The arrangement of the open views of a Dock: splits and tab groups.
    DockLayout.Orientation
    The direction of a split.
    DockLayout.Split
    A split of the space in two.
    DockLayout.Tabs
    A tab group.
    DockRegion
    Where a Placement docks a view against its target: in its tab group, or on one of its sides.
    DockView
    A view shown in its frame's Dock: a content, commands, a scope and resources, with no menu bar or toolbar of its own.
    Placement
    Where Dock.open(Class, Placement) docks a view: against a target, the open view of the target class opened last, or, when target is null or no view of it is open, the whole dock.
